observed.incorrect_inference: Substituting the maximum vertex allowance as an obligatory vertex count falsely ruled out all regular grids.
observed.coverage_interval_correction: ridge.low <= background.high establishes compatibility, not ridge <= background. Under the stated independent interval model, ridge.high <= background.low establishes that scalar ordering, not MSAA subset identity.
observed.projection_correction: Uniform angular texture coordinates do not have uniform screen density under perspective; use the local projection/UV Jacobian.
observed.memory_correction: Mip-chain size alone omitted encoding, decode/import and mesh/authoring buffers. Revised accounted source sum was 29,776,356 bytes, not a measured runtime peak.
observed.erosion_correction: Thermal redistribution can raise a local valley. Validate cap safety after all erosion/blending and on final float32 vertices.

observations.limit: No causal allocation of wasted time and no measured counterfactual saving. Early visual access, macro-form trials, decisive experiments and dependency-scoped reuse are recommendations grounded in the observed failure pattern, not evidence of a specific percentage speedup.
